# DropdownMenu
Atlas Dropdown Menu v1 — a floating menu of actions opened from a trigger. Groups 1–3 (three rows each, groups separated by a Divider); Show Label toggles the heading. Rows are Dropdown Menu Item instances (Type item, destructive, checkbox or radio × State default, focus, disabled).

When to use: a compact list of actions or choices behind a button or a breadcrumb item — account menus, row actions, sort and view options. Use checkbox rows for independent toggles and radio rows for one choice from a set; a row can open a submenu.
When not to use: for navigation between pages (use Tabs or a NavBar), for a form field that submits a value (a select is not part of v1.1), or for a message that needs a decision (use Dialog).

Panel: surface-overlay fill, 1px border, radius-md, shadow-md, 4px padding; 224px wide by default and never narrower than 128px. Opens 4px below the trigger, or above it.

Accessibility: role=menu labelled by the trigger; rows are menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio. Arrow keys move focus, Home and End jump, typing jumps to a match, Enter or Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus, ArrowRight opens a submenu. Disabled rows are skipped. No motion.
